description: Deterministic synthetic Parkstead facilities, policies, inventory, reservation history and original neutral raster illustrations.

sources.description: Deterministic fictional parking records generated by scripts/generate.cjs.
Original neutral facility illustrations generated for this contribution; no logos, maps, real locations, or third-party imagery.

generation.method: AI image generation followed by deterministic PNG downscaling

transformations: Prices are integer cents; 15-minute billable units round up and tax rounds half-up.
Distances are integer meters; displays convert using 1 mile = 1609.344 meters.
Raster illustrations are resized and optimized without SVG conversion.

review.notes: Automated provenance, MIME, integrity and size checks pass; maintainer visual suitability and realism review remains required.
